english: Seven distinct flowers, among them a rose $R$, a lily $L$ and a tulip $T$, are used, all seven at a time. Let $N_{1}$ be the number of garlands that can be made in which $R$ and $L$ are adjacent and $T$ is adjacent to neither $R$ nor $L$. Let $N_{2}$ be the number of ways of placing the same seven flowers at seven equally spaced points around a fixed circular tray, with the same two conditions, where placements obtained from one another by a rotation are regarded as the same and clockwise and anticlockwise orders are regarded as different. Then the value of $N_{1}-N_{2}$ is ______.
hindi: सात भिन्न फूल, जिनमें एक गुलाब $R$, एक कुमुदिनी $L$ तथा एक ट्यूलिप $T$ हैं, सभी एक साथ प्रयुक्त किए जाते हैं। माना कि $N_{1}$ उन मालाओं की संख्या है जिनमें $R$ तथा $L$ आसन्न हैं तथा $T$ न तो $R$ के और न ही $L$ के आसन्न है। माना कि $N_{2}$ इन्हीं सात फूलों को एक स्थिर वृत्ताकार थाल के चारों ओर सात समान दूरी वाले बिन्दुओं पर इन्हीं दोनों प्रतिबंधों के साथ रखने के तरीकों की संख्या है, जहाँ एक-दूसरे से घूर्णन द्वारा प्राप्त व्यवस्थाएँ समान मानी जाती हैं तथा दक्षिणावर्त और वामावर्त क्रम भिन्न माने जाते हैं। तब $N_{1}-N_{2}$ का मान ______ है।
solution: Tray (rotations only): block $RL$ (2 orders) + 5 flowers = 6 units round a circle; fix the block
The 5 places after the block in order: the first and last touch the block, so $T$ has 3 places; the rest $4!$
Garland: an arrangement and its mirror image are the same garland and are different arrangements (distinct flowers), so $N_{1}=\dfrac{N_{2}}{2}=72$
solution_full: Circular tray, rotations identified: tie $R$ and $L$ into a block ($RL$ or $LR$, 2 ways). With the other 5 flowers there are 6 units around the circle.
Fix the position of the block to remove rotations. The other 5 units occupy, in order going round, places $1,2,3,4,5$ after the block; places 1 and 5 are next to the block.
$T$ is adjacent to neither $R$ nor $L$ exactly when $T$ is in place 2, 3 or 4: 3 choices. The remaining 4 flowers fill the other places in $4!=24$ ways.

Garland: a garland can be turned over, so an arrangement and its reflection (clockwise and anticlockwise orders) give the same garland. The conditions are preserved by reflection, and since the flowers are distinct no arrangement equals its own reflection. Hence each garland corresponds to exactly 2 tray arrangements and $N_{1}=\dfrac{144}{2}=72$.
originality_note: New: the same restricted circular arrangement (a pair together, a third object adjacent to neither) counted once as a garland and once on a fixed tray, so the answer isolates the clockwise/anticlockwise factor 2 under a restriction that survives reflection (way 5). Closest known: '7 persons at a round table, two particular persons not together' and 'garlands of n flowers: (n-1)!/2'. Different because: the restriction mixes 'together' and 'not adjacent to a block', and the comparison needs the reflection argument.
blueprint_concepts: Circular permutations; clockwise/anticlockwise; necklace and garland

concept_use.Circular permutations; clockwise/anticlo: Circular arrangements with rotations identified (tray) and with rotations and reflections identified (garland: clockwise and anticlockwise orders are the same), giving the factor 1/2.
